Scheme Name: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Bird’s Unit, 100 Broiler Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Caste People

Short Title: SSBUTSC


Detailed Description:
The "Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Bird’s Unit, 100 Broiler Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Caste People" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to offer subsidies for setting up poultry units and provides a stipend for poultry farming training to promote self-employment and economic upliftment.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be residing in Gujarat.
   1. The applicant must be a Scheduled Caste individual.
   1. The applicant must be an adult (18 years or above).
   1. The applicant must have completed a 6-day poultry farming training.

> **Note:** Females and beneficiaries Below Poverty Line (BPL) will be given priority.


Benefits:
Name of Component	
Standard of Assistance	
Minimum Time Limit(In Year) for Reclaiming Benefits
Subsidy Scheme on establishment of 25 R.I.R. birds unit for Scheduled Caste	
75% of total Expenditure or maximum ₹6,000/- in kind (25 R.I.R. birds and poultry feed)	
Benefit can be given to one member of family. After 3 years the same family can avail benefit.	
Subsidy Scheme for establishment of 100 broiler bird farm for Scheduled Caste	
90% subsidy or Maximum ₹36,000/- RTGS/NEFT (In Bank Account Direct)	
Benefit can be given to one member of family.	
Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Caste	
Maximum ₹2,000/- RTGS/NEFT (in Bank Account Direct)	
Benefit can be given to one member of family.

Scheme Name: COP-5 Financial Assistance to Agricultural Credit Co-operative Banks (PACS/LAMPS) for Reconstruction and Reestablishment (General/Tribal Area)

Short Title: CFAACOBRR


Detailed Description:
The scheme "COP-5 Financial Assistance to Agricultural Credit Co-operative Banks (PACS/LAMPS) for Reconstruction and Reestablishment (General/Tribal Area)" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to make economically weak but functionally efficient PACS/LAMPS financially viable. These societies play a foundational role in the three-tier cooperative credit system, and their performance impacts District and State Cooperative Banks. The scheme incentivizes societies based on their growth in credit disbursement, loan recovery, and deposit mobilization over the past three years (two years for LAMPS).


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a registered Agricultural Co-operative Credit Society, either a Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS) or a Large-sized Adivasi Multi-Purpose Society (LAMPS).
1. The society must have been operational and performing for the required duration:

  -  PACS: At least the last three years.
  - LAMPS: At least the last two years.

1. The applicant must provide performance data for the relevant period, showing:

  - Growth in credit disbursement (short and medium-term).
  - Improvement in loan recovery rates.
  - Increase in deposit collection.


Benefits:
Incentive admissible over and above the average amount of the last three years
Percentage of the grant of incentive on the excess amount
For growth from 10% to 15%	
1 %
For growth above 15% and up to 20%	
1.5 %
For growth above 20%	
2% or a maximum of ₹.50,000/- whichever is less (on deposits up to a ₹2,00,000/- whichever is less)
Note: 
The benefit of the scheme is available only once in a financial year.

Scheme Name: Facilitation of Large Size Godowns in APMC and Taluka-District Purchase Sale Union (General) Short Title: FLSGDPSUG Detailed Description: The scheme "Facilitation of Large Size Godowns in APMC and Taluka-District Purchase Sale Union (General)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to financially strengthen district and taluka-level cooperative purchase and sale unions across the state. The scheme is designed to help such unions undertake critical infrastructure projects, including purchasing, processing, grading, cleaning, packaging, storage, branding, and marketing of agricultural produce, which ultimately benefits the farmers with improved services and higher financial returns. Eligibility Criteria: - Cooperative institutions operating at the taluka or district level within the state of Gujarat are eligible under this scheme. - The institution should be registered under the appropriate cooperative society laws. - The institution should have plans for setting up or expanding facilities like storage godowns, processing units, grading and packaging infrastructure, or branding and marketing systems.
Benefits: Financial Assistance: Provides crucial capital assistance for the construction of large-sized godowns. Infrastructure Development: Supports the development of essential infrastructure for agricultural activities like processing, grading, cleaning, washing, shortening, packaging, and branding. Enhanced Marketing Capabilities: Enables unions to strengthen their marketing and selling capabilities, potentially leading to better prices for farmers' produce. Increased Financial Strength for Unions: Aims to make District and Taluka Purchase-Sale Unions more financially robust and self-reliant. Improved Services for Farmers: Facilitates the provision of better quality services to farmers through stronger unions and improved facilities.

Scheme Name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (Tribal) Short Title: KKYAABMT Detailed Description: the scheme “Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (Tribal)” by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat aims to enhance the competitiveness of agricultural produce markets affected by globalization and liberalization by enabling infrastructure development, modernization, and improved facilities through financial support to Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs). The scheme seeks to create an environment conducive to direct purchase, contract farming, and private market participation to benefit farmers and stakeholders. Objectives of the Scheme: To strengthen infrastructure facilities in APMCs in tribal areas. To modernize and develop competitive and efficient agricultural markets. To support market committees in coping with the changes brought by private sector participation and e-market integration. Eligibility Criteria: - Co-operative Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMC) shall be eligible under this scheme. - The applicant APMC must be located in designated tribal areas within Gujarat.
Benefits: Financial Assistance for Modernization: The scheme provides financial help for the modernization of Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs). Support for Basic Facility Creation: Assistance is offered for the creation of essential and modern facilities within these market committees.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat Short Title: PMMSYSFRGUJ Detailed Description: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland) with the component of the Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir (1000 fingerlings/ha) (3.0 lakh / 1 lakh fingerlings, introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, Through this scheme, various forms of assistance are provided for inland fisheries activities to individuals, societies, self-help groups, and other private entities. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat. Objective: Increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies, increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. Except for water bodies or ponds, in less land, less water, Biofloc with source as well, Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this method, more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this scheme, more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhaar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
Benefits: Stocking of fingerlings in reservoirs: Assistance is provided for stocking 1,000 fingerlings per hectare. The unit cost of the fingerling is ₹3.00/- per piece. Assistance of 40% of the unit cost is given for the General category. Assistance of 60% of the unit cost is given for Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries. Mode of Disbursement: The assistance is paid through a 60% contribution from the Government of India and a 40% contribution from the State Government. Frequency of Disbursement: The benefit of this component can be availed once in a lifetime.

Scheme Name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General) Short Title: KKYAABMG Detailed Description: The scheme "Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to strengthen the infrastructure of agricultural markets in light of the increased competition resulting from globalization, liberalization, and the entry of private players into the agricultural sector. It supports Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) in upgrading facilities such as auction platforms, parking areas, sanitation amenities, and storage systems to facilitate efficient marketing of agricultural products, thereby benefiting both producers and consumers. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Agricultural Marketing Board. Objectives of the Scheme: To upgrade APMCs with infrastructure like auction sheds, cold storage, roads, and weigh-bridges. Scheme Name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Fish Collection Cum Patrolling Boat Gujarat Short Title: ASCFPBGUJ Detailed Description: The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" with the component of "Fish Collection Cum Patrolling Boat" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase fish production in reservoirs and provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals engaged in inland fisheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for purchasing fish collection cum patrolling boats, thereby supporting SC leaseholders involved in reservoir-based fisheries. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries, Government of Gujarat. Objectives: To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. Fishing in reservoirs, aquaculture in ponds, and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individual, a society, a self-help group, an association, a reservoir monopoly, or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.
Benefits: The unit cost to Scheduled Caste Leaseholders is ₹5,00,000/-. Assistance is provided at 75% of the unit cost, which is ₹3,75,000/-, or 75% of the purchase price, whichever is less. The Unit cost for a four-wheel vehicle for the transport of fish to a Scheduled Caste lessee is ₹6,00,000/-. Assistance is provided at 75% of the unit cost, which is ₹4,50,000/-, or 75% of the purchase price, whichever is lower. The Unit cost for a Three-wheel vehicle for the transport of fish to a Scheduled Caste lessee is ₹2,00,000/-. Assistance is provided at 75% of the unit cost, which is ₹1,50,000/-, or 75% of the purchase price, whichever is lower. Frequency of Disbursement: Assistance is given once in a lifetime for each component.

Scheme Name: Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure: Scheme for Development of Green Estate

Short Title: SACEIDGE


Detailed Description:
The "Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to boost industrial growth through financial assistance, modern technologies, and enhanced facilities for industrial parks and clusters.
The component “Scheme for Development of Green Estate” aims to support the relocation or retrofitting of polluting industrial units to designated green estates. The initiative focuses on reducing environmental pollution by providing necessary infrastructure support, ensuring compliance with environmental norms, and promoting sustainable industrial growth.


Eligibility Criteria:
- Industries Commissioner, based on GPCB’s recommendation, will appoint a professional agency for assessing relocation needs.
  - The professional agency will evaluate pollution load, effluent quality, and overall environmental benefits.
  - The study report must be approved by the SLEC committee before project execution.
  - Any institution or group of industries with polluting industrial units recommended for relocation or retrofitting by GPCB is eligible.
  - Infrastructure expenditures for internal roads, power distribution, communication, water supply, sewage, effluent treatment, and other approved facilities are eligible for financial support.


Benefits:
Activity
Assistance
Assistance for preparation of site master plan for relocation /retrofitting of existing polluting industrial units into Green Industrial estate as per the direction of GPCB/MoEF by recognized Science & Engineering Colleges of the State, IITs, NITs, Scientific and R & D institutions, GEMI, GCPC etc.
75% assistance maximum ₹80,00,000/-.
Assistance for setup /relocation /retrofitting of existing polluting industrial units into Green Industrial estate
25% of capital cost or maximum ₹25,00,00,000/-.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Interest Subvention against long terms loan to the Co-operative sugar societies (Normal Area) (Tribal Area)" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provides interest subvention to sugar cooperative societies that availed loans for the payment of sugarcane arrears for the 2018-19 season. The central government covers 1 year of interest subsidy from the loan withdrawal date, after which the state government continues the subsidy for a maximum of 4 years at the lower of the actual interest or 7%.

Scheme Name: Scheme for Management and Purchase of Bulls Provided for Breeding of State Gir/ Kankarej Breed

Short Title: SMPBPBS


Detailed Description:
The “Scheme for Management and Purchase of Bulls Provided for Breeding of State Gir/ Kankarej Breed” launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to support pure breeding of Gir and Kankrej cows by providing financial assistance for purchasing and maintaining high-quality bulls. The goal is to enhance calf quality and gradually increase milk production in rural areas by promoting native breed development.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. A Gram Panchayat or a Gaushala registered must be registered under the Charity Act.
1. The Gram Panchayat or a Gaushala must have a minimum of 100 breedable cows.

**Note:** If there is not sufficient number of breeding cows in a single village, then the breeding cows of the neighboring villages should be covered and a guarantee should be given.


Benefits:
In Case the bull is provided by the Board:
 ₹1,18,000/- in the first year.
In Case the bull is purchased by the organization:
 ₹1,43,000/- in the first year.
Maintenance support: 
₹64,800/- for the second and third year.
Note: 
Assistance provided for three years per eligible organization.

Scheme Name: Scheme to Give Incentive-Prize to Gaushala/ Panjrapole

Short Title: SGIPGP


Detailed Description:
The  "Scheme to Give Incentive-Prize to Gaushala/ Panjrapole" launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to foster healthy competition among Gaushalas and Panjrapoles in the state. By encouraging better animal management practices, the scheme provides incentive prizes to organizations that rank first, second, and third in terms of their operation and management. The prizes are awarded once every three years.


Eligibility Criteria:
- Gaushalas and panjarapol must be registered under the Charity Act.


Benefits:
First Rank: ₹1,50,000/- for the top-ranked Gaushala/Panjrapole.
Second Rank: ₹1,00,000/- for the second-ranked Gaushala/Panjrapole.
Third Rank: ₹50,000/- for the third-ranked Gaushala/Panjrapole.
Frequency: The incentive prizes are awarded once every 3 years.

Scheme Name: Scheme to Assist for Infrastructural Facilities for Gaushalas & Panjrapole

Short Title: SAIFGP


Detailed Description:
The “Scheme to Assist for Infrastructural Facilities for Gaushalas & Panjrapole” launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial aid to registered gaushalas and panjrapoles for building essential infrastructure like cattle sheds, water facilities, and storage areas, ensuring better care for non-productive livestock.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. Any panjarapol and gaushala of the state registered under Public Charity Act.
   1. At least 3 (three) acres of land on which the organization has to construct the development work, must be in the name of the organization or on lease of 99 years. There is no limit on the maximum land.
   1. A gaushala must have more than 50 cows of local origin While Panjarapol must have more than 100 livestock.


Benefits:
Financial assistance of up to 75% of the total cost or ₹4,00,000/-, whichever is lower, for each of the following:
Cattle Shed.
Compound Wall.
Grass Godown.
Water Bore (Electric Motor / Submersible Pump).
Overhead or Underground Water Tank.
Note:
 The benefit of this scheme will be available to an organization for a period of five years for different purpose-components.

Scheme Name: Contribution to State Agriculture Marketing Board Development Fund (General) Short Title: SFCSAMBDG Detailed Description: The scheme "Contribution to State Agriculture Marketing Board Development Fund (General)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote the development of agricultural marketing infrastructure by financially supporting the State Agriculture Marketing Board’s Development Fund. The scheme ensures that the State Government contributes no less than 5% of the total amount deposited in the Development Fund by the Market Committees, thereby enabling cooperative institutions to upgrade and modernize market operations across Gujarat. Eligibility Criteria: 1. Co-operative institutions are eligible under this scheme. 1. The scheme is applicable across the entire state.
Benefits: Monetary Benefits: The scheme ensures a mandatory financial contribution from the State Government, amounting to not less than 5% of the total deposits made by the Market Committees into the Development Fund.

Scheme Name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)

Short Title: ATES/GEPHMEST(HRT3)


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)” is implemented by the Directorate of Horticulture, Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Tribes category as well as to farmer groups and cooperative societies for purchasing various tools, equipment, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment. This includes plastic crates with equipment such as weights, packing materials, sorting/grading machinery, etc.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
   1. The beneficiary should belong to the Scheduled Tribes.
   1. The individual farmer or farmer groups/Cooperative Societies are eligible to avail benefits under the scheme.

**Note 01:** The tool/equipment has to be purchased from the authorised dealer of the empanelled manufacturer for the purpose of price discovery as notified by the Department of Agriculture from time to time.
**Note 02:** Companies empanelled by the Department of Agriculture for tarpaulin seats and their regulations will have to be implemented as per the norms.
**Note 03:** Companies empanelled by the Agriculture Department for plastic crates and have to implement as per its norms.


Benefits:
The Scheduled Tribes farmers will be eligible for assistance up to 75% of the cost of the Tools/Equipment or ₹3,750/-, whichever is less.
Farmer groups/cooperative societies will be eligible for assistance of 90% of the cost of equipment or up to ₹7,50,000/-, whichever is less, for the installation of Post-Harvest Management (PHM) Equipment.

Scheme Name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Fish seed rearing - Gujarat Short Title: ASCFSRGUJ Detailed Description: The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" with the component of Fish Seed Rearing, introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and providing employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this scheme, monetary assistance is provided for fish seed rearing to individuals, societies, self-help groups (SHGs), associations, reservoir monopolies, and private units. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries, Government of Gujarat. Objectives: To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to schedule caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. To boost fish farming or fishing activities in fresh water bodies by schedule caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. Fishing in reservoirs, aquaculture in ponds and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through schedule caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individual, a society, a self-help group, an association, a reservoir monopoly, or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.
Benefits: Spawn to Fry: Assistance of ₹90/- per 1,000 nos. Minimum 30% recovery is required. Each beneficiary will be allocated 3,00,000 spawn. The rearing time is 30 days. Fry to Fingerlings: Assistance of ₹260/- per 1,000 nos. Minimum 35% recovery is required. Each beneficiary will be allocated 2,00,000 fry. The rearing time is 60 days. Spawn to Fingerling: Assistance of ₹460/- per 1,000 nos. Minimum 12% recovery is required. Each beneficiary will be allocated 5,00,000 spawn. The rearing time is 90 days. Frequency of Disbursement: The benefit can be reclaimed after a minimum of 1 year.

Scheme Name: Sagar Khedu Sarvangi Vikas Yojana Short Title: SKSVY Detailed Description: The scheme “Sagar Khedu Sarvangi Vikas Yojana” was launched by the Energy and Petrochemicals Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to accelerate the process of development in 39 taluks of 15 districts of Sagar Kantha (Coastal Area). The scheme aims to resolve the problem of excessive tripping and faults in coastal areas due to corrosion and humidity, ensuring uninterrupted and quality power supply to consumers. The scheme provides improvement of distribution lines, construction of new 66 Kilovolt sub stations, and repair and modernization of transmission lines, along with provisioning 12,000 new agricultural electricity connections. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL). The Government provides share capital contributions to the corporation for execution. Eligibility Criteria: ***The guidelines of the scheme do not define any specific eligibility criteria. However, the target groups benefiting from the infrastructure and connection provisions will be the following:*** - Electricity consumers living in the coastal area. - Industrial, residential, or agricultural customers located in the coastal areas. - Consumers residing within one of the 39 taluks of the 15 districts of the Sagar Kantha area. - Farmer seeking a new agricultural electricity connection in the areas of Paschim Gujarat Vij Company Limited (PGVCL) company.
Benefits: The scheme plans for several infrastructure improvements and resultant benefits for consumers in coastal areas: Infrastructure Improvement: Work is planned for the improvement of distribution lines, construction of new 66 Kilovolt sub stations, and repair and modernization of transmission lines. Voltage and Supply: Industrial and residential customers located in the coastal areas will receive adequate voltage and continuous power supply. Reduced Failures: There will be a significant reduction in the rate of electric motor burnout and transformer failure. Reduced Losses: There will be a reduction in transmission loss and power interruption. Crop Protection: Provision of continuous power supply will prevent damage to crops. Safety: Accidents that occur due to the breaking of power lines can be largely avoided. Development: The all-round development of the villages of the taluks located in the Sagar Kantha area can be achieved. New Connections: New agricultural electricity connections are planned to be provided to coastal farmers (with a target of 12,000 connections mentioned for the financial year 2016-2017). Residential Coverage: Electricity supply is planned for approximately 1,00,000 housings.

Scheme Name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Boat Net - Gujarat Short Title: IFSPTBNGUJ Detailed Description: The scheme “Boat Net” is a component under the “To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas” scheme, introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to boost fish production and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Under this scheme, financial assistance for boats and nets is provided to individuals, societies, self-help groups, associations, reservoir monopolies, private units, and particularly Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries engaged in inland fisheries. Objectives: To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. To boost fish farming or fishing activities in fresh water bodies. Fishing in reservoirs, aquaculture in ponds and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries. The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe fishermen in the state and increase fish production. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private units, etc., involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribes. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
Benefits: Financial Assistance: Tin Boat with Net: 50% assistance of the unit cost, amounting to ₹19,000/-, which includes: Tin Boat: ₹10,000/- Net: ₹5,000/- Lifesaving appliance: ₹4,000/- F.R.P. Boat with Net: 50% assistance of the unit cost, amounting to ₹34,000/-, which includes: FRP Boat: ₹25,000/- Net: ₹5,000/- Lifesaving appliance: ₹4,000/- Frequency of Disbursement: The benefits can be reclaimed after a minimum of 6 year.

Scheme Name: Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)

Short Title: HTASC(HRT4)


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)” is implemented by the Directorate of Horticulture, Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Castes category as well as to FPOs (Farmers Producer Organizations), FPCs (Farmers Producer Companies), FIGs (Farmer Interest Groups), SHGs (Self-Help Groups), and Cooperative Societies for purchasing different harvesting and processing equipment.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
   1. The beneficiary should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
   1. The individual farmer or FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG/Co-operative society is eligible to avail benefits under the scheme.
   1. The assistance will be available once in five years.
   1. Equipment certified by ISO/BIS/ISI/Government recognized organizations should be purchased through an authorized dealer of that company or imported equipment.


Benefits:
The Scheduled Castes farmers will be eligible for assistance up to 50% of the cost of the harvesting tool or ₹1,00,000/-, whichever is less.
FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG/ Cooperative Society will be eligible for assistance of 75% of the cost of the harvesting tool or ₹1,50,000/-, whichever is less.
Note: 
Unit Cost of harvesting tool should be up to ₹2,00,000/-.

Scheme Name: Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)

Short Title: HTAST(HRT3)


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)” is implemented by the Directorate of Horticulture, Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Tribes category as well as to FPOs (Farmers Producer Organizations), FPCs (Farmers Producer Companies), FIGs (Farmer Interest Groups), SHGs (Self-Help Groups), and Cooperative Societies for purchasing harvesting tools.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
   1. The beneficiary should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
   1. The individual farmer or FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG/Co-operative society is eligible to avail of benefits under the scheme.
   1. The assistance will be available once in five years.
   1. Equipment certified by ISO/BIS/ISI/Government-Recognized organizations should be purchased through an authorized dealer of that company or imported equipment.


Benefits:
The Scheduled Tribes farmers will be eligible for assistance up to 50% of the cost of the harvesting tool or ₹1,00,000/-, whichever is less.
FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG/ Cooperative Society will be eligible for assistance of 75% of the cost of the harvesting tool or ₹1,50,000/-, whichever is less.
Note:
 Unit Cost of harvesting tool should be up to ₹2,00,000/-.

Scheme Name: Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure: Scheme of Assistance for Strengthening the Regulation and Environmental Compliance

Short Title: SACEIASRE


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to boost industrial growth through financial assistance, modern technologies, and enhanced facilities for industrial parks and clusters.
The component “Financial Assistance for Common Environmental Infrastructure Facilities” aims to support industries and organizations in establishing and upgrading environmental management infrastructure. It provides financial aid for projects that promote pollution control, waste management, and environmental sustainability.


Eligibility Criteria:
- Industries association / Any Enterprise (except for captive use) or firm which is registered under Societies Act, Trust Act or under the Companies Act.; or GIDC/Board/ Corporations / Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) / PSU / Municipal Corporation / Nagarpalika / Urban Development Authority etc.
  - The project must comply with Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF) &amp; Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) [regulations](https://gpcb.gujarat.gov.in/ViewFile?fileName=%E2%9C%BF84VtA%E2%9C%A45Y2S5am0gZge7C5DIhraFNMo2Ft55An9ZyFCK3Aq9K4dpmnxwVOuBnFXqslsR%E2%9C%A4PycTDCIhX4VZROM%E2%9C%BFi06yKqnt6WggtDpEP%E2%9C%A49qS%E2%9C%A4OqhmJOM%E2%9C%A4HY9NwlZsBW6x0te88%E2%9C%BF%E2%9C%BF0jyrttC7nRRU7AbQ%E2%99%AC%E2%99%AC).  - The project must remain operational for a minimum of 5 years post-completion.


Benefits:
Quantum of Assistance:
 Need based support, maximum ₹50,00,000/-, will be provided as may be decided by the State Level Empowered Committee.

Involves organizations like GPCB, GEMI, and GCPC.

Installation of testing infrastructure to monitor ambient environmental quality.
Real-time and online monitoring systems for continuous data availability.
Data to be shared with GPCB, GEMI, GCPC, and recognized science and engineering colleges.

Identification and mitigation of pollution sources in rivers and vulnerable areas.
Environmental impact assessments for industrial zones, districts, and estates.
Air quality monitoring, emission inventory, and source apportionment studies for affected areas.
Conducted through IITs, NITs, scientific R&D institutions, and recognized Science & Engineering Colleges.

Organized by GPCB, GEMI, and GCPC to promote:
Environmental compliance and enforcement.
Industrial pollution prevention, control, and remediation.
Knowledge-sharing on best practices in environmental sustainability.
5. Environment Clinics:
Establishment of environment clinics to create a common platform for industries, associations, and environmental experts.
Aims to provide expert advice and cost-effective solutions to real-time environmental challenges.
To be executed by GPCB with the help of scientific and R&D institutions, GEMI, GCPC, and recognized science and engineering colleges.
6. Training & Skill Development Programs:
Assistance for establishing training centers or conducting training programs.
Skill development for instructors, operators, and industry managers in environmental management.
Conducted by the Environment and Forest Department, GPCB, GEMI, and GCPC, in collaboration with industry associations.
7. Other Approved Activities:
Any additional activities related to environmental regulation and compliance as approved by the State Level Empowered Committee (SLEC).

Scheme Name: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Setting Up Farmer Support Centers in State Market Committees and for Computerization of All Market Committees

Short Title: SPAFSG


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Scheme to Provide Assistance for Setting Up Farmer Support Centers in State Market Committees and for Computerization of All Market Committees" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to support farmers by setting up information centers and computerizing market committees for better efficiency and transparency.


Eligibility Criteria:
- Market Committees of all areas of Gujarat State shall be eligible for this scheme.


Benefits:
Name of the Component
Standard of Assistance
To create farmer support center
50% of the cost incurred including manpower (employee salaries) or a maximum of ₹2,00,000/-, whichever is less.
To computerize the state market committees
Central software will be developed by the state government.
For necessary hardware/software for computerization of State Market Committees	
For the necessary hardware/software for computerization of the market committees of the state, assistance of up to 90% or ₹2,00,000/- will be provided to the market committees of the state of “K” and “D” categories on the purchase of 2 computers, 2 printers, and software.

Detailed Description:
The "Scheme to Provide Assistance to Sate Market Committees as well as Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Union to Construct Large Size Warehouse Godowns" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to address the storage needs of farmers through providing financial assistance for warehouse godowns construction within market committees. This will allow farmers to store their produce during the harvest season when prices are low and sell it later when market prices improve.


Eligibility Criteria:
- All State Market Committees in Gujarat are eligible to apply.
- The godowns must be used exclusively for the storage of farmers' produce.


Benefits:
Component
Support Standard
Large size warehouse godowns up to 5000 MT in market committees
All State Market Committees, each without considering the class standards will be paid ₹6,500/- per metric ton up to 50% of the project cost will be available for godowns up to 5000 mt

Scheme Name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Equipment in Tribal Areas

Short Title: IFSPETA


Detailed Description:
The scheme "To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Equipment in Tribal Areas" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, is designed to boost inland fisheries by supporting Scheduled Tribes fishermen. It provides assistance for fish seed rearing, stocking, and transportation, as well as financial aid for boats, nets, and fish sale equipment. Additionally, training programs with stipends are available to enhance skills and productivity in the fisheries sector.


Eligibility Criteria:
- Individuals/ societies/ self-help groups/ associations/ reservoir monopolies/ private units etc. involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes.
  - The applicant should be a Fisherman.
  - The applicant should belong to the Schedule Tribe(ST) category.
  - Applicant should be above 18 years of age.
  - The beneficiary fisherman must have his own bank account.

Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits

100% assistance for fish seed and transportation cost

100% assistance for prawn seed and transportation cost for Scheduled Caste lessees

Scheme Name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Prawn Seed Stocking Gujarat Short Title: ASCFPSSGUJ Detailed Description: The scheme “Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" with the component "Prawn Seed Stocking”, introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and to provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this scheme, 100% assistance is provided for the cost of prawn seed and its transportation to Scheduled Caste lessees of reservoirs. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries, Government of Gujarat. Objectives: To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. Fishing in reservoirs, aquaculture in ponds, and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individual, a society, a self-help group, an association, a reservoir monopoly, or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.
Benefits: 100% assistance is given to the lessee of the reservoir of the Scheduled Caste, including the total cost of prawn seed and transportation cost. Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits: 1 Year

Scheme Name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Prawn Seed Stocking - Gujarat Short Title: IFPTPSSGUJ Detailed Description: The scheme “Prawn Seed Stocking” is a component under the “To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas” scheme, introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Under this scheme, 100% financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Tribe lessees of reservoirs for prawn seed and transportation costs. Objectives: To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. To boost fish farming or fishing activities in fresh water bodies. Fishing in reservoirs, aquaculture in ponds and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries. The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe fishermen in the state and increase fish production. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private units, etc., involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribes. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
Benefits: 100% financial assistance is given to Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries who are lessees of reservoirs, covering the total cost of prawn seed as well as transportation costs. Minimum Time Limit for Reclaiming Benefits: 1 year from the date of availing benefit.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Medium Biofloc Establishment - Gujarat Short Title: PMMSYMBEGUJ Detailed Description: The scheme “Medium Biofloc Establishment (25 tanks, 4-meter diameter and 1-meter height)” is a component under the “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)” scheme, implemented by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Under this scheme, various components of inland fisheries, including the establishment of Medium Biofloc and Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and freshwater hatcheries, are supported to accelerate inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies and boost inland fish production. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat. Objective: Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies, increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. Except for water bodies or ponds, in less land, less water, Biofloc with source as well, Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this method, more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this scheme, more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhaar Card/Passport as proof of identity. > **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
Benefits: The scheme provides financial assistance for various inland fisheries activities. For Medium Biofloc Establishment (25 tanks 4 meter diameter and 1 meter height), the unit cost is ₹25,00,000/- per unit. The scale of assistance is as follows: General Category: 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less, is paid as subsidy. Women, Scheduled Caste (SC), and Scheduled Tribe (ST) Categories: 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less, is paid as subsidy. Note 1: The assistance is funded through a 60% contribution from the Government of India and a 40% contribution from the State Government. Note 2: The assistance is provided only once in a lifetime to the beneficiary.

Scheme Name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)

Short Title: ATES/GEPHMSC(HRT4)


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)” is implemented by the Directorate of Horticulture, Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Castes category as well as to farmer groups and cooperative societies for purchasing various tools, equipment, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment. This includes plastic crates with equipment such as weights, packing materials, sorting/grading machinery, etc.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
   1. The beneficiary should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
   1. The individual farmer or farmer groups/Cooperative Societies are eligible to avail benefits under the scheme.

**Note 01:** The tool/equipment has to be purchased from the authorised dealer of the empanelled manufacturer for the purpose of price discovery as notified by the Department of Agriculture from time to time.
**Note 02:** Companies empanelled by the Department of Agriculture for tarpaulin seats and their regulations will have to be implemented as per the norms.
**Note 03:** Companies empanelled by the Department of Agriculture for plastic crates and their regulations will have to be implemented as per the norms.


Benefits:
The Scheduled Castes farmers will be eligible for assistance up to 75% of the cost of the Tools/Equipment or ₹3,750/-, whichever is less.
Farmer groups/cooperative societies will be eligible for assistance of 90% of the cost of equipment or up to ₹7,50,000/-, whichever is less, for the installation of Post-Harvest Management (PHM) Equipment.

Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Castes category as well as to farmer groups and cooperative societies for purchasing various tools, equipment, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment. This includes plastic crates with equipment such as weights, packing materials, sorting/grading machinery, etc.
schemeContent.benefits_md:
1. The Scheduled Castes farmers will be eligible for assistance up to 75% of the cost of the Tools/Equipment or ₹3,750/-, whichever is less.

children.text: The scheme “Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)” is implemented by the Directorate of Horticulture, Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Castes category as well as to farmer groups and cooperative societies for purchasing various tools, equipment, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment. This includes plastic crates with equipment such as weights, packing materials, sorting/grading machinery, etc.

Scheme Name: Scheme of Assistance for Environment Protection Measures: Scheme for assistance to encouraging Green Practices and Environmental Audit to MSMEs

Short Title: SAEPEGP


Detailed Description:
The "Scheme of Assistance for Environment Protection Measures" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, this initiative promotes sustainable industrial growth by supporting industries in adopting eco-friendly practices and ensuring compliance with environmental norms.
The component "Scheme for Assistance to Encourage Green Practices and Environmental Audit for MSMEs" is designed to promote green practices and environmental sustainability in MSMEs by providing financial support for activities such as environmental audits, installation of monitoring systems, and adopting eco-friendly infrastructure.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The industry/unit must be registered under relevant industrial laws in Gujarat.
   1. The industry/unit must comply with existing environmental regulations and standards.
   1. The industry/unit must be engaged in manufacturing or production activities.
   1. The industry/unit must undertake projects focused on environmental protection measures.
   1. The industry/unit must adopt green practices as specified in the scheme.


Benefits:
Eligible Activity
Quantum of Assistance per Project 
Periodic Environmental Audits
Up to 75% of fees with a ceiling of ₹50,000/- per audit.
Installation of Monitoring Systems
Up to 25% of fees with a ceiling of ₹5,00,000/- per audit.
Green Building Certification
Up to 50% of fees with a ceiling of ₹2,50,000/- per audit.
Environmental Management Systems
Up to 50% of fees with a ceiling of ₹10,00,000/- per audit.
Cluster-Based Equipment Purchase
Up to 35% of fees with a ceiling of ₹35,00,000/- per audit.
Wastewater Recovery Systems
Up to 50% of fees with a ceiling of ₹75,00,000/- per audit.

Scheme Name: Scheme of Assistance for Environment Protection Measures: Scheme for assistance to Environment Management

Short Title: SAEPAEP


Detailed Description:
The "Scheme of Assistance for Environment Protection Measures" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, this initiative promotes sustainable industrial growth by supporting industries in adopting eco-friendly practices and ensuring compliance with environmental norms.
The component "Scheme for Assistance to Environment Management" is designed to promote the adoption of cleaner production technologies and advanced pollution control equipment to improve environmental management. It aims to optimize raw material use, reduce energy and water consumption, and minimize waste generation in industries.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The industry/unit must be registered under relevant industrial laws in Gujarat.
   1. The industry/unit must comply with existing environmental regulations and standards.
   1. The industry/unit must be engaged in manufacturing or production activities.
   1. The industry/unit must undertake projects focused on environmental protection measures.


Benefits:
Eligible Activity
Quantum of Assistance per project 
1. Implementation of cleaner production technology in place of existing processes such as substitution and optimization of raw materials, reduction water consumption or energy consumption, or waste generation
1. Upto 35% of the cost of plant and machinery with a ceiling of ₹35,00,000/- during the operative period of the scheme for MSME.        
2. Upto 10% of the cost of plant and machinery with a ceiling of ₹35,00,000/- during the operative period of the scheme for large projects.
2. Any other environment management project with the use of Clean, Efficient, and Innovative Pollution Control Equipment
1. Upto 25% of the cost of plant and machinery with a ceiling of ₹35,00,000/- during the operative period of the scheme for MSME.                    
2. Upto 10% of the cost of plant and machinery with a ceiling of ₹35,00,000/- during the operative period of the scheme for large projects.
Sanctioning Authority:
 Assistance under the scheme will be sanctioned by State Level Empowered Committee and assistance will be disbursed by Industries Commissionerate.

Scheme Name: Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure: Financial Assistance for Common Environmental Infrastructure Facilities

Short Title: SACEIEIF


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to boost industrial growth through financial assistance, modern technologies, and enhanced facilities for industrial parks and clusters.
The component “Financial Assistance for Common Environmental Infrastructure Facilities” aims to support industries and organizations in establishing and upgrading environmental management infrastructure. It provides financial aid for projects that promote pollution control, waste management, and environmental sustainability.


Eligibility Criteria:
- Industries association / Any Enterprise (except for captive use) or firm which is registered under Societies Act, Trust Act or under the Companies Act.; or GIDC/Board/ Corporations / Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) / PSU / Municipal Corporation / Nagarpalika / Urban Development Authority etc.
  - The project must comply with Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF) &amp; Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) [regulations](https://gpcb.gujarat.gov.in/ViewFile?fileName=%E2%9C%BF84VtA%E2%9C%A45Y2S5am0gZge7C5DIhraFNMo2Ft55An9ZyFCK3Aq9K4dpmnxwVOuBnFXqslsR%E2%9C%A4PycTDCIhX4VZROM%E2%9C%BFi06yKqnt6WggtDpEP%E2%9C%A49qS%E2%9C%A4OqhmJOM%E2%9C%A4HY9NwlZsBW6x0te88%E2%9C%BF%E2%9C%BF0jyrttC7nRRU7AbQ%E2%99%AC%E2%99%AC).  - The project must remain operational for a minimum of 5 years post-completion.


Benefits:
General Projects:
 Up to 40% financial assistance, with a maximum limit of ₹50,00,00,000/-.
Government Projects:
 Assistance up to 80% for Government Departments, Agencies, PSUs, and Boards, with a ₹50,00,00,000/-.
Co-Funding with GoI:
 Total assistance from GoI + GoG is limited to 75%, with 25% contribution from the institution.

children.text: Common Effluent Treatment Facilities:
New Common Effluent Treatment Plant (CETP) including collection, storage, and treatment of effluent.
Augmentation and/or technology upgradation of existing CETPs.
Conveyance pipeline for safe disposal of treated effluent.
Recycling of treated wastewater for industrial and other uses.
Common Waste Treatment & Recycling Systems:
Common Spray Drying system for effluent.
Common Multiple Effect Evaporator, Mechanical Vapor Recompression Evaporation (MVRE), etc.
Common Reverse Osmosis (RO) Plant.
Common Drum Decontamination Facility.
Environmental Monitoring & Automation:
Automation of the existing facility.
Installation of monitoring systems for contamination of water, air, land, and noise in the ambient environment.
Online continuous water monitoring and/or Air Emission Monitoring System with connectivity to the GPCB Server.
Common Waste Management Projects:
Common Waste Management Infrastructure Projects, including Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility (TSDF).
Incinerators for hazardous waste and concentrated effluent.
Waste collection, pre-preparation, processing, and treatment facilities for co-processing in power and steel industries.
Recovery, reuse, and recycling of waste from CETP and TSDF by industries association.
Plasma thermal destruction/treatment/waste-to-energy facility.
Specialized Recovery & Recycling Facilities:
Common Solvent Recovery Plant.
Common Spent Acid Recovery Plant.
Use of gypsum through an established environment-friendly technology.
Use of iron sludge through an established environment-friendly technology.
Recovery of waste from E-waste, Electroplating Waste, and Photography Waste.
Recycling facilities for hazardous waste generated during ship-breaking activities.
Waste recycling plants to create useful products/by-products, such as vermicompost and handmade paper from paper mill waste.
PET bottle recycling using indigenous waste.
Other Approved Environmental Management Projects:
Any other environmental management project as approved by SLEC.

Scheme Name: Package for strengthening to sugar co-operatives as may be policy decided by the State Government

Short Title: PFSSCO


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Package for strengthening to sugar co-operatives as may be policy decided by the State Government" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial aid to sugar co-operative societies for projects such as modernization, upgradation, tissue culture labs, molasses-based distilleries, storage system improvements, and cost reduction initiatives. It also offers direct assistance to farmers for the sale of bio-compost, phospho-compost, and vermicompost.


Eligibility Criteria:
- Sugar Co-operative Societies, Members/Farmers of Sugar Co-operative Societies will be eligible for this scheme.


Benefits:
Name of the Component
Standard of Assistance
A project to provide direct assistance to farmers' accounts by sugar cooperatives against sale of bio-compost by sugar cooperatives.
₹100/- per metric ton against the total metric ton sales of bio compost volume. or a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- whichever is less
A project to provide direct assistance to the account of farmers through sugar cooperative societies against the sale of 50 kg bags of phospho compost by sugar cooperative societies.
₹100/- per bag against the sale of a total bag of 50 kg of phosphor compost. or a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- whichever is less
A project to provide direct assistance to farmers' accounts by sugar cooperatives against purchase/sale of produce of 50 kg bags of vermicompost by sugar cooperatives.
₹50/- per bag against the sale of a total bag of 50 kg of vermin Compost or maximum ₹6,50,000/- whichever is less.
Project for setting up of new tissue culture labs by sugar co-operative societies
50% of the project cost or a maximum of ₹40,00,000/- whichever is less 
Project for extension of existing labs (other than civil works) to sugar cooperatives having tissue culture labs.
50% of the project cost or a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- whichever is less
Installation of electricity motor instead of turbine, construction of new tank for molasses/rectified spirit storage, mechanization in sugar harvesting, distillery capacity upgradation, increase in ethanol storage capacity, new godown construction, steam economy project, boiler modification, 3 MW turbine etc. Among all these projects, any one project to be done by the organization considering the priority
25 % of project cost Or a maximum of ₹1,00,00,000/- whichever is less

Scheme Name: Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers to Increase the Area, Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming

Short Title: IASCASF


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers to Increase the Area, Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to support Scheduled Caste farmers by providing cash incentives for high-quality seeds, modern farming techniques, and agricultural mechanization. The scheme encourages farmers to enhance productivity and profitability.


Eligibility Criteria:
- The applicant must be a farmer.
  - The applicant must be from Gujarat state.
  - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
  - The applicant must be a householder.
  - The farmer must be engaged in sugarcane cultivation.
  - Farmers applying for the 10% incentive must demonstrate excellent production using high-quality seeds, agricultural inputs, and modern farming practices.


Benefits:
Name of Component
Standard of Assistance
Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming  Benefits
Assistance for sugarcane Sowing
₹10,000/- per Hectare
Every year
10% assistance for excellent production
10% extra benefit per metric ton for production exceeding 70 metric Tons/Hectares.
Every year
Note: 
This scheme covers a cultivation area of 500 hectares of sugarcane for Scheduled Tribe farmers.

Scheme Name: Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Caste Area)

Short Title: CDGSCA


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Caste Area)" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial support to Village Milk Producer Co-operative Societies in Scheduled Caste areas that lack their own milk storage or cattle feed storage infrastructure. It also promotes installation of bulk milk coolers and similar equipment.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The Society must not already own a Dudhghar or Godown.
   1. The Society must have its own land available for the construction of the Dudhghar or Godown.
   1. The Society must not have availed of the benefit earlier under this or any other scheme for a similar purpose.

Dudhghar/ Godown
Unit price (₹10,00,000/-)or actual expenditure occurs for construction, out of that 50% of whichever is less.

Once in lifetime

Scheme Name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries

Short Title: ATSCF


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, is designed to boost inland fisheries by supporting Scheduled Caste fishermen and fish farmers. It provides assistance for fish seed rearing, stocking, and transportation, as well as financial aid for boats, nets, and fish sale equipment. Additionally, training programs with stipends are available to enhance skills and productivity in the fisheries sector.


Eligibility Criteria:
- Individuals/ societies/ self-help groups/ associations/ reservoir monopolies/ private units etc. involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes.
  - The applicant should be a Fisherman.
  - The applicant should belong to the Schedule Caste(SC) category.
  - Applicant should be above 18 years of age.
  - The beneficiary fisherman must have his own bank account.


Benefits:

Standard of Assistance
Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits

₹90/- per 1000 spawn to fry (30% recovery); ₹260/- per 1000 fry to fingerlings (35% recovery); ₹460/- per 1000 spawn to fingerlings (12% recovery); Rearing time: 30, 60, 90 days
1 Year

100% assistance for fish seed and transportation cost
1 Year

100% assistance for prawn seed and transportation cost for Scheduled Caste lessees

Once in a lifetime

₹1,250/- stipend after 10-day training; ₹125/- per day during training
Once in a lifetime

Scheme Name: Fodder Development Scheme For Gram Panchayat, Gaushala And Panjarpol Having Gauchar Land

Short Title: FDSGPGP


Detailed Description:
The "Fodder Development Scheme For Gram Panchayat, Gaushala And Panjarpol Having Gauchar Land" launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to improve the fertility and productivity of gauchar land by supporting activities like removal of weeds, ploughing, sowing of fodder seeds, and fencing. By enhancing the availability of green fodder, the scheme not only boosts milk production and cattle health but also improves the rural environment and creates employment.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. Village panchayats having land for gauchar, gaushala and panjrapoles 
   1. Gauchar, gaushala and panjrapoles must be registered under the Public Charity Act.


Benefits:
Component
Standard of Assistance
Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Constituent Benefits
Fodder Development Scheme for Gram Panchayat, Gaushala and Panjarapol having gauchar land	
For developing cow pastures in an area of up to 20 hectares are assisted with 75% of per hectare expenditure up to a maximum of ₹75,000/- i.e. A maximum assistance of ₹15,00,000/- for a total of 20 hectares.
The benefit of this scheme will be available only once.

Scheme Name: COP-37 (General Area) 50% Capital Subsidy Scheme for Project of Taluka & District Co-op. Purchase Sale Union Short Title: CSSPTDCP Detailed Description: The scheme "COP-37 (General Area) 50% Capital Subsidy Scheme for Project of Taluka & District Co-op. Purchase Sale Union" by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to strengthen the financial base of cooperative buying and selling unions in talukas and districts by providing 50% capital assistance with a maximum limit of ₹20,00,000/- for a wide range of agricultural projects. These projects include procurement of inputs like fertilizers and seeds, as well as infrastructure and service improvements such as processing, grading, cleaning, washing, shorting, packaging, branding, storage, and marketing of agricultural produce. By empowering these cooperative institutions, the scheme seeks to ensure better quality services and economic benefits for farmers and primary agricultural credit societies. Eligibility Criteria: 1. Taluka or District Cooperative Purchase and Sale Associations are eligible under this scheme. 1. Taluka and District Purchase and Sale Associations should have their own land.
Benefits: Financial Assistance: Provides a 50% capital subsidy to cooperative unions, with a maximum limit of ₹20,00,000/-. Improved Services for Farmers: Enables unions to offer better and more diverse services to farmers, such as providing quality agricultural inputs, procuring produce at support prices, and offering modern processing and storage facilities. Enhanced Infrastructure: Supports the development of infrastructure like storage godowns, processing units, and marketing channels, which benefits the entire agricultural supply chain. Increased Market Access: Helps unions establish better marketing and branding of agricultural produce, potentially leading to better prices for farmers' products.

Helps unions establish better marketing and branding of agricultural produce, potentially leading to better prices for farmers' products.

Scheme Name: Scheduled Castes Unsalaried Credit Co-operative Society and Credit and Supply Co-operative Scheme for Providing Managerial Assistance and Computer–Furniture to the Society Short Title: SCUCCOCSC Detailed Description: The scheme “Scheduled Castes Unsalaried Credit Co-operative Society and Credit and Supply Co-operative Scheme for Providing Managerial Assistance and Computer–Furniture to the Society” by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote the financial inclusion and operational efficiency of Scheduled Caste Savings and Credit Co-operative Societies by offering managerial support and necessary infrastructure. These societies, formed to serve members of the Scheduled Castes through loan and credit services, often lack resources to appoint qualified managers or procure essential office furniture and computer systems. Through this scheme, the government offers financial assistance to help societies pay managerial salaries and purchase basic office infrastructure. Eligibility Criteria: - The society must be registered under the Co-operative Act. - The society must be a Scheduled Caste Savings and Credit Co-operative Society. - The society should be formed exclusively by members belonging to the Scheduled Castes. - The applicant society must be registered within the last three financial years prior to the application year.
Benefits: Managerial Assistance: A maximum of ₹8,000/- per month is provided for an employee's salary, totaling Rs. 0.96 lakh per society on an annual basis. Computer and Furniture Assistance: A maximum of Rs. 0.62 lakh per society is provided for the purchase of computers and furniture.

Scheme Name: Scheme for Granting Assistance to Processing Units in APMC (General Area) Short Title: SGAPUG Detailed Description: The scheme "Scheme for Granting Assistance to Processing Units in APMC (General Area)" by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to encourage establishment of agro and food processing units in the general areas of Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) to increase farmers’ income, reduce post-harvest losses, generate employment opportunities, and improve supply chain efficiencies. The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of capital subsidy to co-operatives institutions that set up processing units. Eligibility Criteria: - Co-operative institutions are eligible under this scheme. - The institutions must set up a processing unit in the general area of an APMC.

Benefits: Variable Grant Amount: The grant percentage is tailored to the needs of different market committees, offering 25% for 'A' and 'B' class committees and 50% for 'C' and 'D' class committees. Maximum Assistance: The maximum financial assistance provided under the scheme is capped at ₹1,50,00,000/-, ensuring substantial support for eligible projects.

Scheme Name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Fish Seed Stocking - Gujarat Short Title: ASCFFSGUJ Detailed Description: The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" with the component of "Fish seed Stocking", introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this scheme, 100% assistance for the cost of fish seed and transportation is provided to Scheduled Caste fish farmers and fishermen to boost fish farming and fishing activities in freshwater bodies. The scheme is implemented for the benefit of Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries, Government of Gujarat. Objectives: To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. Fishing in reservoirs, aquaculture in ponds, and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individual, a society, a self-help group, an association, a reservoir monopoly, or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.
Benefits: 100% assistance is given to Scheduled Castes for the cost of fish seed and the total cost, including transportation. Note: Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits: 1 Year

Through this scheme, assistance is provided for boat nets, which are provided to Scheduled Caste fishermen and fish farmers. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries, Government of Gujarat. Objectives: To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. Fishing in reservoirs, aquaculture in ponds, and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individual, a society, a self-help group, an association, a reservoir monopoly, or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.
Benefits: Tin Boat-Net Unit: 50% of unit cost or ₹7,500/- (Boat: ₹5,000/-; Net: ₹2,500/-), whichever is less. F.R.P. (Fibre-Reinforced Plastic) Boat-Net Unit: 50% of unit cost or ₹15,000/- (Boat: ₹12,500/-; Net: ₹2,500/-), whichever is less. Conditions/Aspects/Criteria Associated: Benefit amount is calculated based on 50% of the unit cost or the fixed maximum amount mentioned above, whichever is less. Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits: 6 Years

Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for purchasing fish sale equipment to SC fish farmers and fishermen. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries, Government of Gujarat. Objectives: To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. Frequency of Disbursement: This benefit can be availed once in a lifetime.
